name: IWL World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Walked from Sid, the tournament winner on the fed's own founding card, through a dozen real-wrestler-persona reigns across 1996-97, ending the surviving record still around Ken Shamrock's waist after Balance of Power '97.

name: IWL United States Championship
epitaph: Dean Malenko's own title more than any other wrestler's, held by him at least twice across the surviving record and voted the fed's own Best US Champion two years running, before ending the surviving record on Tracy Smothers.

name: IWL World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won by Public Enemy at the fed's own founding tag tournament and changed hands often enough that the fed's own Top Ten list joked about weekly title changes; Public Enemy alone reclaimed it a fourth time before it moved on twice more in the surviving record's final months.
